meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, select or create the agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把首个智能体接入私信频道并发出欢迎消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你刚布置好智能体服务,想快速接通私信频道。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your first agent to a DM channel and send a welcome message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just set up an agent service and want to quickly wire it to a DM channel.

howto.what: 引导你创建第一个 NanoClaw Agent 并绑定到私信频道：确认身份后运行初始化脚本，让该 Agent 发一条欢迎私信给你。
howto.when: 它在频道凭据已配置好、服务运行后使用；当你想创建第一个 NanoClaw Agent 并收到它的欢迎私信时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建第一个NanoClaw Agent，让它私信我一条欢迎消息
say.note: Claude会先问频道再要你的ID和显示名

say.text: 我想把第一个agent接到Telegram并收到它的欢迎私信
say.note: 会引导你确认Telegram上的身份

say.text: 请帮我初始化第一个agent，频道用Discord
say.note: 需要你先给Discord机器人发一条私信

howto.what_en: Guides the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel: asks for the channel and identity, runs the init script, then has the agent send a welcome DM.
howto.when_en: Used after channel credentials are configured and the service is running, when the operator wants to create the first NanoClaw agent and get a welcome DM from it.

say_en.text: Create my first NanoClaw agent and have it DM me a welcome message.
say_en.note: Claude will ask for the channel and your user ID.

say_en.text: I want my first agent on Telegram, and I'd like a welcome DM from it.
say_en.note: Claude will confirm your Telegram identity.

say_en.text: Let's initialize my first agent on Discord.
say_en.note: You'll need to DM the bot once on Discord first.
